subject: primary_restrained_candidate_expression
metric_contract: false_positive_proxy_rate_delta <= -0.050; pool_normalized_positive_yield_delta > 0; avg_pool_ratio_b_vs_a <= 1.500; positive conversions remain non-trivial.
repeat_contract: Pass on at least one future/fresh window for continued research; prefer two independent fresh confirmations before rewrite spec.
permission_if_met: Keep as provisional primary shadow design seed.
permission_if_not_met: Return to Stage 6B diagnostics; no rewrite permission.

subject: concentration_warning_break
metric_contract: Primary can pass with warnings only if metrics repeat and concentration warnings are explicit; concentration alone cannot confirm a macro finding.
repeat_contract: At least one non-March fresh window, preferably two.
permission_if_met: Mark evidence as repeat-confirmed with concentration caveat.
permission_if_not_met: Keep finding provisional and do not promote to system rule.

subject: support_context_modifier
metric_contract: support-on subset must reduce FP proxy or improve yield versus support-off peer while not materially expanding pool exposure.
repeat_contract: Must pass narrowed-bucket evidence before entering any scoring rewrite.

subject: restraint_soft_penalty
metric_contract: soft penalty must reduce FP pressure versus no-penalty reference while preserving materially useful positive conversions; hard veto is forbidden at this stage.
repeat_contract: Soft-penalty workbench must show stable calibration before rewrite design.
permission_if_not_met: Keep restraint as diagnostic warning only.

subject: lineage_narrowing
metric_contract: narrowed lineage must improve or preserve FP/yield versus primary while adding non-duplicate conversions.
repeat_contract: Narrowing candidate plus fresh replay confirmation.
permission_if_not_met: Keep broad lineage as foundation reference only.

subject: decay_companion_boundary
metric_contract: decay remains companion-only; no candidate permission even when carrying useful explanatory hits.
repeat_contract: Boundary must remain explicit in every fresh-window readback.
permission_if_not_met: Audit decay wiring before more replay work.

subject: duplicate_credit_guardrail
metric_contract: candidate union must not claim duplicate scoring credit.
permission_if_not_met: Stop rewrite path until duplicate-credit issue is repaired.

subject: macro_findings_gate
metric_contract: repeat evidence exists and caveats are logged.
repeat_contract: One fresh repeat minimum; two preferred for rewrite influence.
permission_if_met: Promote to macro findings log with repeat-confirmed posture.

subject: translator_scoring_rewrite_gate
metric_contract: all prerequisite gates pass or remain explicitly quarantined.
permission_if_met: Draft rewrite specification only, not live deployment.
